blueprint.central_question: What did the physical evidence show the Antikythera mechanism could actually do?
blueprint.thesis: The physical evidence from its gears and inscriptions shows that this 2nd century BC device could predict astronomical positions and eclipses decades in advance, and track athletic game cycles.
blueprint.why_it_matters: It demonstrates the advanced mechanical capabilities of ancient Greek technology.
blueprint.viewer_start: The viewer knows an ancient artefact called the Antikythera mechanism exists.
blueprint.viewer_end: The viewer understands the specific astronomical and calendar-tracking functions revealed by the physical components of the mechanism.
